en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Is’haq Bin Ammar that, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘It is for them to pass by Al-Medina, so they would greet upon Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> from nearby, even though the Blessings do reach him<sup>saww</sup> from afar’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said to them (Hammad and Ishaq), ‘
You should pass by al- Madinah and offer al-Salam to the Messenger of Allah from nearby, although it reaches him from faraway places also.’”
